verdict.rationale: Abacum documents its own permission system: group-based role assignment for managing user permissions across the workspace. That is the mechanism this story would rely on. However, the evidence never says permissions can be scoped to a department or dimension so a budget owner sees and edits only their own numbers. missing for 10: documented department/dimension-level data scoping, separate view vs edit rights per scope, evidence that budget owners can enter inputs without seeing company-wide data, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, department-scoped permissions let a budget owner see and edit their numbers without exposing the whole company

citations.quote: With group-based role assignment, Abacum lets you assign and manage user permissions easily across your workspace, all from a single, code-free interface.
